# Bolt

Bolt gives Obsidian a clean, Android-style Material Design look, including rounded tables. Its recorded description presents the styling as ready to use out of the box, with a minimal, easy-to-read interface and no configuration named.

![Bolt screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bluemoondragon07/Obsidian-Bolt/HEAD/cover.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Bolt"
    author: "bluemoondragon07"
    repo:   "bluemoondragon07/Obsidian-Bolt"
    slug:   "bolt"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/bolt"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/bluemoondragon07/Obsidian-Bolt"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bluemoondragon07/Obsidian-Bolt/HEAD/cover.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Give Obsidian a clean, Android-style Material Design look with rounded tables and simple, ready-to-use styling. Keep a minimal, easy-to-read interface that works out of the box."
}
```
